scope: Narrow repair recheck of the ordinary idle coordinator helper, added source-only subprocess tests, and new idle/stop assertions.

resolved_findings.previous: Empty password corrupted inherited command JSON during unconditional redaction.
resolved_findings.evidence: make_idle_view now supplies a nonempty fixed NON_CREDENTIAL redaction sentinel. It is not passed to enrollment, login, HTTP, native argv or environment. The source-only regression invokes the actual inherited command method with a real owned Python subprocess and requires exact decoded JSON plus reaping.

resolved_findings.previous: An arbitrary exit-2 startup failure could be credited as duplicate coordinator denial.
resolved_findings.evidence: require_duplicate_denial bounds the actual captured log to 65536 bytes and requires the exact startup schema and OWNER_SCOPE_BUSY. run invokes it after the expected exit-2 command and still requires original role-token equality. The regression exercises real exit-2 subprocess outputs, rejects INVALID_CONFIGURATION and accepts OWNER_SCOPE_BUSY.

additional_checks: Idle snapshots now require no public market selection, no Paper runs, unchanged engineering lifecycle, workflow_authorized false, unchanged selected generation and unchanged policy bytes.

Graceful stop requires actual STOPPED status, financial authority NONE, exposure NOT_ASSERTED, host settings UNCHANGED, exactly control/research/runtime roles and every role stopped without force, exit 0 and reaped. Existing cleanup failure paths still force passed false.

The helper remains explicitly ordinary idle/recovery evidence. Software-only policy serializations and service-supervision authorization do not claim a positive Paper lifecycle, operator policy acceptance, market feed, real forward or financial grant.
limits: Static source review only. No subprocess test, native process, qualification, database/auth/config content, active evidence, provider or network was executed or accessed by the reviewer. Root-reported source-test results are separate evidence. Actual native helper success and complete qualification remain pending and are not asserted here.
